# ENCE - Naive vs Warmstart vs Active-Set Plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
tag          <- "Implementations_Sweep"
results_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_implementations_sweep_%s.rds", tag)
log_file     <- sprintf("section_4_2_implementations_sweep_%s.txt", tag)

results <- readRDS(results_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

## Unpack

```{r unpack, results='hold'}
meta <- results$meta
cat("ENCE Section 4.2.3\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " K:", meta$K, " seed:", meta$seed,
    " stations:", meta$n_stations, " observed:", meta$n_observed,
    " n_years:", length(meta$years),
    " years:", paste(range(meta$years), collapse = "-"), "\n\n")
cat("description:", meta$description, "\n")
cat("run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
cat("hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
    " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
cat("R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n\n")

true_y      <- results$true_y
naive_y     <- results$naive_y
warmstart_y <- results$warmstart_y
active_y    <- results$active_y

naive_rmse     <- results$naive_rmse
warmstart_rmse <- results$warmstart_rmse
active_rmse    <- results$active_rmse

naive_val_list     <- results$naive_val_list
warmstart_val_list <- results$warmstart_val_list
active_val_list    <- results$active_val_list

n_cut <- min(sapply(naive_val_list, length), sapply(warmstart_val_list, length), sapply(active_val_list, length))
naive_val     <- rowMeans(sapply(naive_val_list,     function(v) v[1:n_cut]))
warmstart_val <- rowMeans(sapply(warmstart_val_list, function(v) v[1:n_cut]))
active_val    <- rowMeans(sapply(active_val_list,    function(v) v[1:n_cut]))
```

```{r metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(true_y, naive_y,     "Naive",     results$naive_time)
report_metrics(true_y, warmstart_y, "Warmstart", results$warmstart_time)
report_metrics(true_y, active_y,    "Active-set", results$active_time)
```

## Timings

```{r timings, results='hold'}
naive_time_vec     <- results$naive_time_vec
warmstart_time_vec <- results$warmstart_time_vec
active_time_vec    <- results$active_time_vec

cat("Per-fold wall time (s):\n")
print(rbind(naive = round(naive_time_vec, 2),
            warmstart = round(warmstart_time_vec, 2),
            active = round(active_time_vec, 2)))

speedup_ws_naive <- naive_time_vec / warmstart_time_vec
speedup_act_naive <- naive_time_vec / active_time_vec
speedup_act_ws <- warmstart_time_vec / active_time_vec

cat("\nPer-fold speedup, mean +/- sd:\n")
cat("warmstart vs naive:   ", round(mean(speedup_ws_naive), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_ws_naive), 2), "\n")
cat("active vs naive:      ", round(mean(speedup_act_naive), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_act_naive), 2), "\n")
cat("active vs warmstart:  ", round(mean(speedup_act_ws), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_act_ws), 2), "\n\n")
```

## Scatterplots

```{r scatterplots, results='hold'}
plot_obs_pred(true_y, naive_y,     "Naive")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, warmstart_y, "Warmstart")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, active_y,    "Active-set")
```

## Convergence

```{r convergence_plot, results='hold'}
col_naive <- "#234ec2"
col_ws    <- "#c20d0d"
col_act   <- "#1c9e5b"

xlim_range <- c(1, max(length(naive_rmse), length(warmstart_rmse), length(active_rmse)))
plot(naive_rmse, type = "b", col = col_naive, pch = 15,
     xlim = xlim_range,
     ylim = range(c(naive_rmse, warmstart_rmse, active_rmse)),
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Internal RMSE (between cycles)",
     main = "Convergence: Naive vs Warmstart vs Active-set")
grid()
lines(naive_rmse,     type = "b", col = col_naive, pch = 15)
lines(warmstart_rmse, type = "b", col = col_ws,    pch = 17)
lines(active_rmse,    type = "b", col = col_act,   pch = 18)
legend("topright", legend = c("Naive", "Warmstart", "Active-set"),
       col = c(col_naive, col_ws, col_act), pch = c(15, 17, 18), lty = 1)
```

```{r val_rmse_plot, results='hold'}
col_naive <- "#eb7500"
col_ws    <- "#7008d1"
col_act   <- "#0d8fc2"

xlim_range <- c(1, max(length(naive_val), length(warmstart_val), length(active_val)))
plot(naive_val, type = "b", col = col_naive, pch = 15,
     xlim = xlim_range,
     ylim = range(c(naive_val, warmstart_val, active_val)),
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Validation RMSE (masked cells)",
     main = "Validation RMSE: Naive vs Warmstart vs Active-set")
grid()
lines(naive_val,     type = "b", col = col_naive, pch = 15)
lines(warmstart_val, type = "b", col = col_ws,    pch = 17)
lines(active_val,    type = "b", col = col_act,   pch = 18)
legend("topright", legend = c("Naive", "Warmstart", "Active-set"),
       col = c(col_naive, col_ws, col_act), pch = c(15, 17, 18), lty = 1)
```
